Subject: Steering Committee: Redwood Inference + FinSync — Exec sponsor & next steps

Thanks again for the call earlier today — great discussion and appreciate the clear signals on priority use cases and timelines. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can align the right stakeholders for a steering committee / exec review:

Recap:
- Primary use case: customer-facing document summarization (legal and billing docs) — latency and hallucination controls are top priorities.
- Decision criteria called out on the call: accuracy on legal text, SLA-backed latency for peak hours, and strong security controls (data isolation / KMS).
- Procurement timeline: target vendor selection by mid-August; risk assessment required for SaaS vendors.

Proposed next steps:
1) Schedule a 30–60 minute steering committee with exec sponsor + security/procurement/legal + engineering owners to review technical fit, risk, and commercial terms.
2) Share a one-pager + proposed agenda (attached) for the meeting.
3) Draft a mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones (we've started one; will share link).

Proposed dates (all in PDT):
- Tue 27 Jul, 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed 28 Jul, 09:00–09:30 or 16:00–17:00

Can you confirm the exec sponsor (economic buyer) and the people you'd like on the steering committee? Also, any procurement/legal/security contacts we should loop in now so we can prep the vendor risk materials they'll request.

Attaching: Steering_Committee_One-Pager.pdf, Proposed_Steering_Agenda_v2.docx

Thanks — happy to adjust timing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
